findings.why: lag_k_blip is spec kind estimate (value 2) not a parameter. Script reports it by constant assignment to the paper's value instead of computing it from the estimated lag profile (e.g., argmax/significance over c_k). Subsequent append uses that constant: results.append({"name":"lag_k_blip","value": lag_k_blip_val ...}). The lag regressions are estimated but never used to derive which k is the blip; the reported estimate is set to a constant/paper value, not computed from data.
